epoch_configuration.override_bug: build_params(epochs) gives the explicit stage default precedence over RLPR_EPOCHS. Both public training entry points always supply an argument; changing RLPR_EPOCHS or params_full.epochs alone does not change these defaults.
epoch_configuration.resume_semantics: epochs is target total count, not additional epochs. Resuming epoch1 with target1 executes zero updates.
epoch_configuration.paper_limitation: Provided PDF does not specify MulRan epoch counts; public script defaults are not proof of the complete training history of released weights.

cross_modal_control_training_curve.interpretation: Training loss is still lower at the end of epoch1, supporting a longer-training experiment but not guaranteeing validation or test recall improvement.

static_dataset_notes.mulran: gen_bev concatenates train/test indexes only for independent BEV preprocessing. Training loaders use sejong and kaist train indexes. Sejong02 train-region queries are explicitly included in training; its geographic test region is separate.
static_dataset_notes.nuScenes: gen_info merges official trainval and test metadata. BS uses bs_db.npy for both training and test database, and names bs_test_query.npy as validation. Current trainers discard that validation loader; no backward path through it was found. BS train/test indexes are not present locally, so their actual query intersections are unverified. gen_index.py does not generate the BS indexes used by training.
static_dataset_notes.snail_hercules_boreas: Static configuration: Snail uses separate train/test sequence lists; Hercules trains RiverIsland and tests SportsComplex; Boreas is evaluation-only. Actual data intersections beyond MulRan were not checked.
